columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Country to which the Geography belongs. Must use two-letter ISO code. Example: United States is US. Use the Manage Tax Geographies task to identify valid values.

columns.name: STATE_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: State jurisdiction code for creating the concatenated jurisdiction code. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: COUNTY_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: County jurisdiction code for creating the concatenated jurisdiction code. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: CITY_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: City jurisdiction code for creating the concatenated jurisdiction code. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: COUNTRY_STATE_ABBREVIATION
columns.description: Abbreviation for country or state based on whether this record is for a country or state. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NAME
columns.description: Primary name of the geography. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date for the tax rate. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be earlier than the EFFECTIVE_TO date.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date for the tax rate. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be later than the EFFECTIVE_FROM date.

columns.name: ZIP_BEGIN
columns.description: Lowest value in the zip code range. There must not be overlapping zip ranges.

columns.name: ZIP_END
columns.description: Highest value in the zip code range. There must not be overlapping zip ranges.

columns.name: JURISDICTION_SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Indicates whether geography is inside or outside city limits. Valid values: 0, 1. 0 means outside city limits. 1 means inside city limits.
